automations.name: New Lead Follow-Up
automations.summary: When someone claims an offer on your website or through a Facebook lead form, this follows up right away by email and text, connects your office by phone if they don't reply, and checks in again the next day.
glance: Someone claims an offer on your website or a Facebook lead form
1 call to connect with the new lead
The next day, after the check-in text

steps.title: Someone claims an offer
steps.body: The follow-up starts when someone submits the Claim Offer form on your website or a Facebook lead form.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: The lead is added to your lead board
steps.body: They're added to the Marketing Pipeline as a New Lead, and also start the Long-Term Nurture emails (automation 5).

steps.title: Email 1: Thanks for claiming our offer

email.subject: Thanks for claiming our offer [First name]
email.body:
Thanks for claiming our [Promotion name] promotion [First name]!

We're looking forward to seeing you. Be sure to check out our calendar to schedule your appointment: [Booking link]

We also shot you a text if you have any questions in the meantime.

Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery

steps.note: [Promotion name] comes from a custom value in your account. Please confirm what the promotion is called so it reads correctly.

steps.title: Text 1: Thanks for claiming our offer
steps.sms:
Hi [First name], thanks for claiming our [Promotion name] promotion - Have you been to a medical spa in the past?

- Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery
steps.note: This text asks about a “medical spa”. If that isn’t how you describe your practice, we can change the question. It also has no opt-out wording (“Reply STOP to opt out”), which carriers expect on the first message.

steps.when: If they reply and want to book
steps.gap: Waits up to 2 minutes for a reply
steps.title: Text 2: If they reply and want to book
steps.sms: Got it, so you know a little about what to expect. And just as a reminder: if you haven't already, be sure to schedule an appointment on our calendar here: [Booking link] You can also call us directly at [Practice phone]
steps.body: When someone replies, they move to Hot Lead on your lead board. If their reply shows they want to book, they get this text.
steps.note: The booking link in this message uses a merge field ({{custom_values.marketing__website_booking_page_url}}) we couldn't find in your account's custom values. If it isn't set up, the link will be blank. We'll confirm it before going live.

steps.when: If they reply but aren't ready
steps.title: Text 2: If they reply but aren't ready to book
steps.sms: No problem. The next step is to book a time to come in - grab a spot that works for you here: [Booking link]

steps.when: If there's no reply after 2 minutes
steps.gap: If there's no reply after 2 minutes
steps.title: Your office is connected to the lead
steps.body: Your office phone rings with the message “A new lead has been generated. Their name is [Contact name]. Press any key to connect with [First name].” Pressing a key calls the lead.

steps.title: A recorded voicemail is left
steps.body: A pre-recorded voicemail is dropped on the lead's phone.
steps.note: We couldn't see a recording attached to this step. Please send us the voicemail you'd like to use, or we can help you record one.

steps.title: Text 3: Any questions?
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just checking back to see if you're ready to book an appointment so we can apply your discount. Are there any questions we can answer for you in the meantime? - Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery

steps.title: The follow-up ends
steps.body: The lead leaves this automation. They keep getting the weekly Long-Term Nurture emails until they buy.

questions.text: What is the offer or promotion called?
questions.why: It's filled into the first email and text as [Promotion name].

questions.text: Should the first text ask about a medical spa?
questions.why: The question came from a template. It may not fit a plastic surgery practice.

questions.text: Who should get the call when a new lead doesn't reply?
questions.why: Right now the call goes to your main office line.

automations.name: Appointment Confirmation + Reminders
automations.summary: When an appointment is confirmed, this sends a confirmation email, then reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before the visit.
glance: An appointment is confirmed in your main calendar

steps.title: An appointment is confirmed
steps.body: Starts when an appointment is confirmed in your main booking calendar.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: The new-lead follow-up stops
steps.body: The patient leaves the New Lead Follow-Up and moves to New Booking on your lead board.
steps.note: They don't leave the Long-Term Nurture emails (automation 5), so they'll keep getting promotional emails after booking. We recommend stopping those too. See Question 1.

email.subject: Spa Appointment Confirmation

Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery

email.body:

steps.note: The subject says “Showroom Visit”, which came from a template. We recommend “your appointment is in one hour”.

steps.title: Text 1: Your appointment is in one hour
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just a friendly reminder that your Appointment is in one hour. Please confirm you're still available by replying YES - Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery
steps.note: This asks the patient to reply YES, but nothing happens when they do. Your team would need to watch for replies, or we can remove that line.

steps.title: The reminders end
steps.body: The patient leaves this automation at the appointment time.

questions.text: Should the Long-Term Nurture emails stop once someone books?
questions.why: Right now they keep going after booking.

questions.text: Would you like a text reminder the day before too?
questions.why: Today the day-before reminder is email only.

questions.text: What should happen when a patient replies YES to the 1-hour text?
questions.why: Nothing is set up to handle the reply.

automations.name: Missed Appointment Follow-Up
automations.summary: When a patient misses their appointment, this sends a reschedule email and text straight away, then one more text the next day if they haven't replied.
glance: An appointment is marked No-show in your main calendar
The next day, or as soon as the patient replies

steps.title: A patient misses their appointment
steps.body: Starts when an appointment in your main calendar is marked No-show.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: Email 1: Let's get you rescheduled

email.subject: Let's get you rescheduled [First name]!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Sorry you weren't able to make it to your appointment - let's get you rescheduled!

You can book another day/time that will work for you by clicking here: [Booking link]

We look forward to seeing with you!

Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery
[Practice address]

steps.note: There's a small typo: “seeing with you” should be “seeing you”. The booking link in this message uses a merge field ({{custom_values.marketing__website_booking_page_url}}) we couldn't find in your account's custom values. If it isn't set up, the link will be blank. We'll confirm it before going live.

steps.title: Text 1: Let's get you rescheduled
steps.sms:
Hi [First name]! Sorry you weren't able to make it to your appointment - let's get you rescheduled!

You can book another day/time that will work for you by clicking here: [Booking link]

We look forward to seeing you! - Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery

steps.gap: 1 day later, if they haven't replied
steps.title: Text 2: Checking back in
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just wanted to check back to see if we can get you rescheduled or if you had any questions we can help with - Palm Beach Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery

steps.title: The follow-up ends
steps.body: The patient leaves this automation. It also stops early as soon as they reply.

questions.text: Should your team be alerted when someone misses an appointment?
questions.why: Right now nobody on your team is notified.

automations.name: Review Request After a Sale
automations.summary: When a lead is marked Won, this stops the promotional emails, sends a review request by email and text, and reminds your team 3 days later to check whether a review came in.
glance: A lead is marked Won on your lead board
1 review request email, 1 review request text
Day 3, after your team is reminded

steps.title: A lead is marked Won
steps.body: Starts when a lead in the Marketing Pipeline is marked Won.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: The Long-Term Nurture emails stop
steps.body: The patient leaves the Long-Term Nurture emails (automation 5).

steps.title: Review request email
steps.body: Your standard review request email is sent, with a link to leave a Google review.
steps.note: This uses the review request set up in GHL's Reputation settings. We'll add the exact wording here for you to review.

steps.title: Review request text
steps.body: Your standard review request text is sent, with a link to leave a Google review.
steps.note: This also uses the wording from your Reputation settings. We'll add it here for you to review.

steps.title: Your team is reminded to check for a review
steps.body: Everyone on your team gets an email: “Has [Contact name] left a review yet?”

steps.title: The review request ends
steps.body: The patient leaves this automation.

questions.text: Who should get the 3-day review reminder?
questions.why: Right now it goes to every user in your account.

questions.text: Is “Won” the right moment to ask for a review?
questions.why: Some practices prefer to wait until after the procedure or follow-up visit.

automations.name: Stale Leads Clean-Up
automations.summary: Leads that sit in the same stage of your lead board for 7 days without any activity are marked Abandoned, so the board stays current.
glance: A lead has no activity for 7 days

steps.title: A lead has had no activity for 7 days
steps.body: Starts when a lead has sat in New Lead, Hot Lead or Booked for 7 days with nothing happening.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve. These triggers also point to a lead board that no longer exists in your account, so they would never fire. We'll reconnect them to your Marketing Pipeline.

steps.title: The lead is marked Abandoned
steps.body: The lead moves to Abandoned on your Marketing Pipeline.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Nothing is sent to the patient.

questions.why: Longer consult cycles may need more time before a lead is written off.

questions.text: Should booked patients be marked Abandoned after 7 days?
questions.why: Someone booked 3 weeks out would be marked Abandoned before their visit.
